findings: Only immutable RMQstorage and AncestorLadder are shared through shared_ptr<constDeepQueryData>; each LCA retains independent vertices,roots,and parenttable. Public rebuild replaces state rather thanmutating shared tables.
Pooled RMQstorage consists of dfs[N],parententrykeys[N],masks[N],sparse[B*levels]. Count guard n<=maximum_count/3 and B<=(maximum_count-3n)/levels bounds all element and byte arithmetic.
Parent-entry range minimum identity and componentroot early return proved independently; block32 monotone masks and sparse ranges preserve minima.
Copy shares immutabledeep data and deepcopies vertices,roots,up; move/swap includesdeep_,block_count_,shallow_,levels_. No self-reference or ownershipcycle.

Before scratch reuse, parentarray copied into up_; ladder receives up_ asimmutableparent, old parentbuffer asheight, stackbuffer asheavy, and disjoint final thirdbuffer asorder. All scratchwritten before read.
Ladder indices fituint32 via explicitn<=UINT32_MAX/2; 2N entries fit ptrdiffbyteguard.
Deep levels1 keeps row(v)=v andcopycountN; climb dispatchblock_countnonzero; reroot shortcut usesdedicated shallow_=(H<=1), avoiding deep1mode ambiguity.
Conditional GNU compiler attributes disappear on other compilers; no nonstandard arithmetic or SIMD dependency. Requested pedanticC++23/no-native builds validate standard fallback.

notes: 公式25件+補足3件をGCC15.2/Clang21・検査有効無効で112出力照合。
独立参照、任意ラベル・任意の根・森・RMQ境界、全API、共有表の寿命、確保失敗を通常20programsで検証。
新RMQ境界・確保失敗をGCC/Clang各2本ASan+UBSanでも確認。検査無効は通常構成で検証。
ASan detect_leaks=0は環境都合。確保失敗試験のlive_delta=0を別途確認。
本体には専用SIMDや128bit拡張を追加していない。GNU/Clangのinline属性は条件付きで、他コンパイラでは通常の関数になる。
mainと入出力のSHAは旧38e提出と同一。現行本体のオンラインACとは区別する。
